analysis.summary: During the H1 FY26 earnings conference call, Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crores, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crores, representing a 49.08% year-on-year growth in revenue. Management highlighted that the company is expanding its portfolio into adjacent categories like Soya Chunks and upcoming puja/devotional articles while maintaining its focus on core markets like Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the demand environment is encouraging and expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum in the second half.
guidance.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management noted that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margin.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated they have very good response from the market for groundnut oil.
demand_outlook.quote: But we are having very good response from the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that groundnut oil sales represent 7% to 8% of the overall oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Generally, overall if you see the positioning of the groundnut oil is percentage wise 7% to 8% is the overall sales of this oil segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that sesame oil and safflower oil constitute 1% to 2% of market share.
demand_outlook.quote: Sesame oil and safflower oil, it is 1% to 2% of market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that approximately 70% of the spices market remains unorganized.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that roughly 70% of atta is in loose unorganized form.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading, and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items, and allied products.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The new edible oil plant commenced commercial production on 10th May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for spices and masalas stands at 3,600 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven and not making losses.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they are spending Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs monthly on media channels.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05%.
The Profit Margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 9.14%.
Cart value for oil, ghee and other products is 15% to 20% with margins of 18% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming depreciation for six months.
margins_costs.quote: Still the one thing I want to focus and just give the clarity on that. Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the installed capacity for Spices is 3,600 tons with a utilization of 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that short-term borrowings increased mainly due to an overdraft (OD) that came on the last day of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they will go for bank debt if needed for expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be going for the debt as of now. If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Bank credit facility limit stands at INR12 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: INR12 crores is a facility, INR200 lakhs is a facility with the banking.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that Paushtik is no longer a wholly-owned subsidiary and is not connected to Srivari anymore.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is no more connected to Srivari, the supply chain and the Paushtik. It belongs to the supply chain and that company is no longer a wholly owned subsidiary company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that growth targets were not reached last year due to new setup challenges and delays in rights.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, as we have in the earlier this investor's meet we have committed some growth percentage and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup. It's a huge setup and second thing was the delay in the rights.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are planning to launch the new puja and devotional products vertical in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they plan to expand manufacturing capacity for Atta and Spices within 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

management_commitments.claim: Srivari Spices and Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of the 'Neihaa Narayan' puja devotional articles vertical.
management_commitments.quote: Srivari Spices & Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
